name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Guard.rank_collision_budget
title: Rank charged to erroneous off-diagonal context matches
statement: For a uniform finite seed, perfect diagonal acceptance, width at most r, and at most c accepting seeds per unequal pair imply 2 s n ≤ 2 s r + n (n-1) c, for an n-context bilinear field test with s seeds.
